title: Business Development Specialist
description:
We are seeking an ambitious and results-driven Business Development Manager specialized in engineering services to join our team in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. This role is essential for expanding our footprint in the engineering sector, driving new client acquisition, and strengthening strategic partnerships across Brazil's key industries such as oil & gas, infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, and construction.
You will focus on selling a range of engineering solutions including design, consulting, project management, EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction), technical staffing, and specialized engineering services. If you have a strong network in Brazil's engineering ecosystem and a proven ability to win complex, high-value contracts, this is your opportunity to play a pivotal role in our growth in one of Latin America's most dynamic markets.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and develop new business opportunities in the engineering services sector across Brazil, with a primary focus on Rio de Janeiro and surrounding regions.
Prospect and qualify leads through targeted outreach, industry events, referrals, and digital channels (LinkedIn, sector-specific networks).
Build and maintain long-term relationships with key decision-makers in oil & gas companies, infrastructure developers, industrial manufacturers, energy firms, and government-related entities.
Develop tailored proposals and solutions that address clients' engineering challenges.
Lead the full sales cycle: from initial contact, needs assessment, and technical presentations to contract negotiation and deal closure.
Collaborate with engineering, delivery, and technical teams to ensure proposals are competitive and aligned with client requirements.
Track market trends, competitor activity, regulatory changes, and upcoming projects (e.g., via ANP, IBAMA, public tenders) to inform strategy.
Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets for engineering services contracts.
Represent the company at industry events, trade shows (e.g., Rio Oil & Gas, OTC Brazil), and professional associations in Rio and São Paulo.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Petroleum, or related) or Business Administration. MBA or postgraduate studies are a plus.
5+ years of experience in B2B business development or sales within the engineering services sector (consulting, design, EPC, technical outsourcing, etc.).
Proven track record of winning and closing high-value engineering contracts (ideally >R$1M).
Strong existing network in Brazil's engineering market, particularly in Rio de Janeiro (oil & gas, energy, infrastructure sectors highly desirable).
Fluency in Portuguese and English (Spanish is a bonus). Excellent presentation and negotiation skills.
Familiarity with public and private tender processes in Brazil
Proficiency in CRM tools
Ability to understand technical engineering requirements and translate them into commercial value propositions.
Self-starter with strong hunter mentality, capable of working independently in a target-driven environment.

title: Comprador
description:
REGULAMENTO DO PROCESSO SELETIVO
O CENTRO DE ESTUDOS E PESQUISAS CIÊNTIFICAS FRANCISCO ANTÔNIO DE SALLES – FAS, através do presente regulamento torna pública a abertura das inscrições e estabelece normas relativas à realização do Processo Seletivo para a vaga descrita abaixo, a ser contratada sob o Regime CLT por contrato de experiência. O presente processo seletivo não se trata de Concurso Público, não decorrendo, portanto, qualquer estabilidade diferente das que permitidas e exigidas pela CLT para contratos de experiência.
Os dados pessoais que serão aqui coletados têm o intuito de cadastrar os interessados no Processo Seletivo para o cargo de Interesse. Ressaltamos que o acesso a essas informações e sua utilização é restrita aos responsáveis do Recursos Humanos.
DO PROCESSO SELETIVO
1.1 O Processo Seletivo é regido pelas disposições contidas neste regulamento e seus anexos, possíveis adendos ou retificações e demais publicações pertinentes que serão disponibilizadas no site do FAS:
1.2 O presente Processo Seletivo será realizado sob a responsabilidade do Recursos Humanos e Comissão de Processo Seletivo, designada pelo FAS, de acordo com as normas estabelecidas neste Edital.
1.3 Não será permitida mais de uma inscrição por candidato, caso ocorram, a segunda inscrição será desconsiderada.
1.4 É DE RESPONSABILIDADE EXCLUSIVA DO CANDIDATO, ACOMPANHAR todas as etapas do Cronograma e as publicações que poderão ser disponibilizadas NA PÁGINA DO PROCESSO SELETIVO no endereço eletrônico e ou através de contato telefônico / e-mail (não serão aceitos outlook, live, Hotmail) . *O candidato que perder a data da próxima convocação não terá direito a pedido de recurso*.
1.5 O Processo Seletivo terá validade de 3 meses a partir da data de contratação do candidato selecionado, podendo, mediante necessidade do FAS.
1.6 O cargo, o número de vagas, a carga horária semanal, o vencimento mensal e os pré-requisitos exigidos para contratação serão informados na entrevista.
1.7.6 o Processo Seletivo Será Composto De
1ª ETAPA - Inscrição, de caráter eliminatório;
2ª ETAPA - Análise dos documentos exigidos para cada cargo, de caráter eliminatório;
3ª ETAPA - Avaliação de Competências e Habilidades Comportamentais, de caráter eliminatório e classificatório. Para esta etapa, serão convocados os candidatos classificados na Etapa de Análise documental considerando o mínimo de 03 (três) candidatos por vaga e/ou para formação de cadastro reserva;
4ª ETAPA - Entrega de Documentos e Exame médico, de caráter eliminatório.
Somente possuirá direito a contratação o candidato que, após participar de todas as etapas previstas, for aprovado e classificado.
Descrição Do Cargo
Elaborar pedidos de compra e acompanhar todo o fluxo de entregas;
Realizar negociações com fornecedores, garantindo as melhores condições comerciais;
Acompanhar e solucionar pendências junto ao setor financeiro;
Desenvolver e manter o relacionamento com fornecedores, negociando margens, avaliando indicadores e monitorando preços de mercado;
Acompanhar o processo de compras por meio de relatórios gerenciais;
Realizar o controle de inventário e níveis de estoque;
Assegurar a assertividade das compras por meio da análise do estoque real x estoque necessário;
Gerenciar a carteira de compras, revisando e analisando a base de fornecedores e buscando novas oportunidades;
Elaborar, acompanhar e apresentar indicadores de desempenho;
Criar mapas comparativos de preços, identificando as propostas mais vantajosas para a empresa.
Requisitos
Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Logística, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
Domínio do Pacote Office, com Excel avançado (essencial para análises e elaboração de relatórios).
Experiência sólida na área de Compras, preferencialmente no segmento de atuação da empresa (ex.: Administração da Saúde Pública), incluindo utilização do sistema Bionexo e sistemas de gestão (ERP).
Conhecimento prático em Excel avançado e no ERP Sankhya será considerado um diferencial.
Benefícios

Vale alimentação R$ 500,00 + Vale refeição R$ 35,00 dia;
Plano de saúde e plano odontológico;
Wellhub (Gympass);
Descontos em lojas, cursos de inglês e universidades;
Convênio Sesc.

Horário de Expediente: 09:00 às 18:00

description:

The Team
You will be part of the S&P Global Energy Customer Success team. The support advisor plays a key-role in helping to secure renewals, close new business and deepen our relationships with clients. We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Experiência na função;
Disponibilidade para deslocamento.

Nossa essência inspira nosso dia a dia, por isso, buscamos alguém alinhado ao propósito de cuidar das pessoas;
Alguém que zele por cuidado e empatia durante toda a jornada, trazendo o cliente sempre para o centro das ações, buscando a excelência;
Desejo de aprender, valorização do trabalho em equipe e troca de conhecimento.

Seguro de vida.

Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.

title: Auxiliar de Laboratório
description:
Descrição da vaga
Nascemos em 2017 com o propósito de ser a melhor empresa de saneamento para o Brasil.
Hoje, estamos presentes em diversos municípios e estados brasileiros, com o objetivo de contribuir para que o país alcance a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto.
Nosso modelo de negócios consiste em concessões e parcerias público-privadas (PPPs).
Somos uma das principais companhias de saneamento do país, inserida na vida de comunidades de diferentes portes e atendendo milhões de pessoas.
Inovação, sustentabilidade, geração de valor e foco na satisfação do cliente fazem parte da nossa cultura organizacional. Venha fazer parte dessa transformação com a gente
Local: ETE Barra - Avenida Ayrton Senna Barra - Rio de Janeiro - RJ.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Coletar amostras de água tratada, analisando os parâmetros designados conforme orientação do gestor imediato;
Coletar amostras de água bruta e efluentes conforme padrões, encaminhando para análise laboratorial;
Executar de acordo com instruções recebidas atividades em laboratório, apoiando nos serviços de: lavar, preparar, desinfetar e esterilizar os materiais utilizados em coletas e nos laboratórios, manter limpa e asséptica a área do laboratório, lavagem de material, almoxarifado e área de recepção de amostras físico-químicas e bacteriológicas;
Receber, inspecionar, cadastrar e distribuir as amostras coletadas aos setores;
Desempenhar, conforme orientação recebida e quando necessário, atividades para as quais esteja qualificado, visando atender a necessidade da empresa, situações emergenciais e/ou de aprendizado profissional;
Cumprir cronograma de limpeza/desinfecção e manutenção preventiva/corretiva de equipamentos utilizados nos laboratórios, campo e o veículo de locomoção;
Lançar dados gerados em laboratórios em planilhas específicas;
Zelar pela manutenção, limpeza, assepsia, conservação e utilização de materiais, instrumentos e equipamentos do laboratório e campo;
Dirigir veículos da empresa para realização de serviço de campo, zelando pela segurança e normas de trânsito estabelecidas.
Cumprir e as normas de sustentabilidade (segurança, higiene, qualidade, preservação ambiental, saúde e a metodologia de 5S).
Requisitos e qualificações
Vaga Afirmativa PCD;
Ensino Médio Completo;
CNH B Definitiva e válida
Conhecimento Pacote Office.
Desejável: Cursando Ensino Técnico em Química ou Meio Ambiente;
Na Iguá Saneamento valorizamos a diferença em todos os contextos e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre. Como companhia e time, buscamos a equidade e respeitamos todos os tipos de diversidade (Gênero, Deficiência - PcD, LGBTQIAPN+, Étnico racial, Crenças e Gerações). Venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação
Informações adicionais
Nossos Benefícios
Aqui, cuidamos das nossas pessoas em todas as etapas da sua jornada como colaborador. Conheça o que oferecemos:
Saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida
Plano de Saúde extensivo aos dependentes

Rede de parcerias e descontos em produtos e serviços

VENHA TRABALHAR COM A GENTE
Em 2017, nascemos com um propósito: ser a MELHOR empresa de saneamento PARA o Brasil.
Desde então, nos consolidamos como uma das principais empresas do setor no país e estamos presentes em seis estados brasileiros (Alagoas, Mato Grosso, São Paulo, Paraná, Rio de Janeiro e Sergipe), beneficiando milhões de pessoas por meio de nossas concessões e parcerias público-privadas. Atuamos com o compromisso de proporcionar mais qualidade de vida e saúde à população atendida, por meio de um trabalho responsável e de excelência no fornecimento de água tratada e nos serviços de coleta, afastamento e tratamento de esgoto.
Mais do que uma atividade empresarial, encaramos a universalização do saneamento básico como um compromisso de larga escala com a vida, com as pessoas, com o meio ambiente, com nossos parceiros e com o desenvolvimento sustentável do Brasil. Esse propósito guia nossas decisões e reforça, todos os dias, o nosso compromisso em cada gota.
O nosso jeito de ser é marcado por um DNA inovador, que promove um ambiente acolhedor, respeitoso e repleto de aprendizados, gerando impacto positivo na sociedade. A valorização e o respeito às diferenças fazem parte da nossa cultura, promovendo uma atuação ética, inclusiva e um ambiente psicologicamente seguro para mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas negras, pessoas LGBTQIA+, independentemente de crenças, idade ou qualquer outro marcador social ou identitário. Buscamos equidade e respeito em nossas equipes e acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação. Já somos mais de 2.800 colaboradores e seguimos com perspectivas de ir ainda mais longe.
Você já se perguntou qual é o seu propósito e que história deseja escrever para a sua vida e carreira? Sempre sonhou em ter um papel protagonista e impactar positivamente a vida de milhares de pessoas? Aqui, você pode fazer parte dessa transformação.

title: Analista de Operações Logísticas
description:
Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria.
Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.
A equipe da Amazon Logistics Brasil (AMZL) está procurando uma pessoa Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time de EDSP (External Delivery Service Providers), ou seja, as estações de entrega da AMZL operadas por parceiros. Essa pessoa irá atuar como Torre de Controle para essas operações operadas por parceiros, em turno 4x3. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, os Analistas de Operações Logísticas são todos em turno 4x3, separados entre equipe front e back.
Essa pessoa atuará na gestão de estações de entreda dos parceiros logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos desses parceiros. Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas.
Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria /visitas aos parceiros logísticos in loco.
Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não celebramos apenas a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, celebramos as diversas formas como trabalhamos. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador e ele o conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.
Key job responsibilities
Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento eficiente dos parceiros logísticos, sugerir e implantar melhorias;
Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os parceiros logísticos;
Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas;
Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos;
Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;
Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais;
Basic Qualifications
Bacharelado em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas.
MS Office, com nível avançado em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros).
Habilidade para multitarefas, gerenciando vários parceiros simultaneamente com atenção aos detalhes.
Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados.
Disponibilidade para viagens em 10% do tempo.
Inglês básico.
Preferred Qualifications
Inglês avançado.
Experiência em acompanhamento de processos, métricas e resolução de problemas.
Experiência em Logística, Transportes.

title: Analista de Planejamento e Controle Jr
description:
Descrição da vaga
A Aegea
Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.
A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.
Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.
Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.
Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.
A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.
Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Planejar e programar as ordens de serviço de manutenção eletromecânica, considerando manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, conforme criticidade dos ativos.
Dimensionar horas de manutenção (HH), avaliando capacidade da equipe e reservando margem para atendimentos corretivos.
Verificar e assegurar a disponibilidade de recursos necessários à execução das ordens de serviço (mão de obra, materiais, ferramentas e terceiros).
Controlar prazos, escopos e execução das atividades, garantindo aderência ao planejamento técnico.
Monitorar indicadores de manutenção (MTBF, MTTR, backlog, cumprimento de planos e custos por OS).
Analisar falhas recorrentes e históricos de manutenção, propondo melhorias nos planos e processos.
Elaborar relatórios analíticos para suporte à tomada de decisão da liderança.
Atuar como interface entre manutenção, operação, engenharia e suprimentos.
Apoiar auditorias por meio da organização e controle da documentação técnica e histórico de manutenção.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Superior cursando ou completo em Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
Vivência em planejamento e controle de manutenção.
Experiência com gestão de ordens de serviço, backlog e priorização de atividades.
Conhecimento de Excel avançado e ferramentas de planejamento (Project).
Experiência com sistemas de manutenção, preferencialmente SAP.
Perfil analítico, organizado e dinâmico, com boa capacidade de comunicação.
Informações adicionais
Assistência médica;
Assistência odontológica;
Seguro de vida;
Vale transporte;
Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
Zenklub - atendimento direcionado à saúde mental;
AE Orienta - Aconselhamento Psicológico, Financeiro, Jurídico e social;
Gympass - Acesso a academias e demais atividades de bem-estar;
Auxilio creche para as mães;
Empréstimo consignado em folha;
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.
#Rio
Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta
A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.
Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Delayed Coker Visbreaker Specialist-Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.
Job Overview
We are seeking an experienced Delayed Coker/Visbreaker Engineering Specialist to join the Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD).
OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.
Your primary role is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for refineries' delayed Coker and visbreaker, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support, benchmarking, and technology knowledge management
Key Responsibilities
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Conduct comprehensive performance reviews of existing delayed coker/visbreaker facilities, and analyze KPIs related to operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.
Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly-owned and affiliates), and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement in delayed coker/visbreaker technologies.
Deliver on-demand remote and field technical advisory support, including troubleshooting, optimization, debottlenecking, revamp, and upgrade activities and provide detailed service reports for each support activity.
Drive performance improvement programs that enhance process safety, optimize manufacturing costs, and increase plant reliability for delayed coker/visbreaker units.
Develop and implement best practices and standards for delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and maintenance, while ensuring alignment with industry standards and regulations.
Provide expert technical support to project teams and contractors for delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and procurement activities.
Coordinate with other disciplines (process, mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical) to ensure optimal performance and integration of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
Conduct regular audits and inspections of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment to ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality regulations and standards.
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and innovations for delayed coker/visbreaker improvement and optimization.
Minimum Requirements
You will hold a Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred.
You will have a minimum of 15 years of experience across the refinery and/or petrochemical industry, with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in delayed coker/visbreaker specialty.
You will be able to optimize delayed coker/visbreaker operations, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
You will have comprehensive knowledge of delayed coker/visbreaker processes, equipment, and systems in refining and petrochemical industries.
You will have deep understanding of ASME Section VIII Divisions 1 & 2, ASME Section I, API-530, API-535, API-537, API-560, API-579, API-936, and NFPA standards applicable to fired equipment.
You will have Significant experience in inspection and failure analysis of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
You will have proficiency in basic and advanced NDE techniques related to delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
High level of proficiency in using software tools related to delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and design, such as Aspen Hysys, ANSYS, and HTRI.
You will have knowledge of remaining life calculations for heater tubes and refractory design and repair.
You will have excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to prepare and present technical reports to various audiences.
You will also have strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.
Working Environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

title: Program Manager, Grantee Experience
description:
Program Manager, Grantee Experience - Independent Contractor
Scope of Services
This is an independent contractor engagement, not an employment role. The successful contractor will provide services under a defined scope and will not be engaged as an employee.
Project Overview
Tilt Collective is engaging an independent contractor to provide program and grantee engagement support to strengthen relationships with partners and grantees across key portfolios. The engagement will initially focus on Brazil and US grant making, with additional support across Tilt Collective's countries and programs as required.
The Contractor will provide specialist support to enhance program implementation, strengthen compliance processes, and improve communication between Tilt Collective and its organizational partners. The Contractor will operate independently, using their own professional expertise and judgement, while collaborating with Tilt Collective stakeholders as needed to deliver the agreed services.
Scope of Services and Deliverables
The Contractor will provide the following services. Percentages indicate anticipated focus and do not guarantee a minimum or maximum time allocation.
Partner relationship management and communication (approximately 40%)
Act as an additional point of contact for routine partner and grantee communications, as agreed with Tilt Collective
Facilitate structured check-ins with partner grantees, in coordination with relevant Program Staff, to support progress tracking and issue identification
Coordinate translation support and cross-cultural communication requirements, particularly in Brazil
Support strategic communications between Tilt Collective and grantee partners Provide input and recommendations to help maintain productive partner relationships aligned with program objectives
Grant making process support (approximately 40%)
Support the adaptation and localisation of grant making policies, processes, and documentation to improve accessibility and contextual relevance, particularly for Brazil
Draft and contribute to internal grant making documents, including nomination forms and investment memos
Review grant proposals and provide written assessments against agreed strategic and program criteria
Support compliance and due diligence processes by preparing documentation and inputs as requested by the Grants Team
Contribute recommendations to improve grantmaking tools, procedures, and documentation
Additional grantee engagement and learning support (approximately 20%)
Support the implementation and use of MEAL tracking tools to monitor grantee progress and outcomes
Contribute to the preparation of progress updates and summary reports for internal or external use
Identify themes, trends, and learning points across grantee engagement and share insights with Tilt Collective stakeholders
Term and Time Commitment
The anticipated start date is as soon as reasonably practicable, with an expected commencement by Q1 2026.
The engagement is expected to average up to 20 hours per week for planning purposes. Tilt Collective guarantees a minimum commitment of 15 hours per week for the first six months of the engagement.
Hours above this level may be required by mutual agreement and in line with agreed deliverables and timelines. The Contractor retains discretion over how and when the services are performed, subject to meeting those deliverables and timelines.
Collaboration and Communications
The Contractor will work primarily with the Grants Director, who will serve as the primary point of contact. Regular touchpoints may be scheduled to align on priorities, deliverables, and timelines. These touchpoints are intended for coordination and information sharing and do not create a reporting or supervisory relationship.
Performance and Deliverables
Successful delivery will be assessed based on the quality, timeliness, and completeness of agreed outputs, including but not limited to:
Grant making documents produced
Proposal reviews and written assessments completed
Partner and grantee engagement activities delivered
Contributions to process improvement and learning
Feedback from relevant stakeholders, including the Grants Team and Program or Country leadership, may be used to inform the overall assessment of the services delivered.
Fees and Payment
Fees will be paid monthly following submission of an invoice detailing services provided during the applicable period, in accordance with the agreed contract terms. Finance will confirm final payment mechanics separately.
Contractor Skills / Requirements
Necessity for fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English
Location in Brazil, USA, or a similar time zone
Ability to commit for six months

title: Manager, Cleaning and Waste Management
description:
Department: Technical & Infrastructure
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The Cleaning and Waste Management Manager, reporting to both FIFA27 Head of Infrastructure & Technical Services and the FIFA Technical Services Senior Manager, will be a key member of the FIFA27 team. This role involves close coordination with key stakeholders to meet operational, environmental, and service quality standards.
The position is responsible for developing, coordinating implementation, and overseeing sustainable cleaning and waste management strategies and operations from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This includes leading upstream and downstream waste management and ensuring a seamless, high-quality tournament experience in line with FIFA's and regional sustainability standards.
The ideal candidate will combine event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management expertise with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA's stringent standards.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Act as the primary liaison between FIFA Functional Areas, Local Entities, contractors, and external stakeholders for sustainable cleaning and waste management services.
Lead and manage cleaning and waste management team, ensuring efficiency and high performance.
Develop and implement the Sustainable Waste management strategy and cleaning operational plan, ensuring alignment with FIFA's requirements.
Develop and manage sustainable cleaning and waste management services budget, ensuring cost control and operational efficiency.
Lead the planning, installation, and operations of temporary waste management infrastructure across stadiums, training sites, and other FIFA Official Sites.
Ensure full integration of cleaning and waste management requirements, maximizing the use of existing venue infrastructure while meeting FIFA standards and event operational needs.
Oversee the end-to-end delivery of sustainable cleaning and waste management services, managing resources, partners, suppliers, and contractors to ensure successful execution.
Conduct site visits to validate operational readiness, ensuring feasibility, quality, and compliance with operational needs.
Oversee the planning and delivery of temporary power, lighting, and other essential technical services for Resource Recovery Centers.
Ensure compliance with FIFA's facility management standards.
Collaborate with stadium facility management teams, suppliers, and local authorities to guarantee operational readiness by the highest sustainability standards.
Provide regular updates to the FIFA Technical Services Senior Manager on key milestones, issues, and recommendations.
Coordinate with local authorities the process to secure necessary permits and approvals.
Track and report on project progress, identifying risks and mitigation strategies.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and innovation in service planning and delivery.
YOUR PROFILE
Bachelor's or Master's in Resource Management, Economics, Sustainability, Facility Management or a related field.
Minimum 10+ years of experience planning and executing sustainable cleaning and waste management services for major sporting events.
Proven track record of leading cleaning and waste management service teams in FIFA tournaments or similar global events.
Experience in budget management, procurement, and supplier coordination.
Strong understanding of stakeholders' requirements and responsibilities to deliver efficient and sustainable operations.
Extensive knowledge of cleaning and waste management delivery, temporary infrastructure, and venue technical services for major sporting events.
Proficiency in project management tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

No Grupo DPSP (lojas, corporativo e CDs), saúde vem em primeiro lugar, é com esse propósito que cuidamos todos os dias de milhões de brasileiros. Seguimos com ética, respeito e excelência para ser a primeira escolha dos nossos clientes e colaboradores.
E agora além de ser nosso cliente, você tem a chance de fazer parte do nosso time
Responsabilidades:
Conduzir e apoiar processos seletivos de vagas operacionais para o público de PCD, desde a triagem até a entrevista, assegurando aderência ao perfil e às necessidades do negócio;
Garantir a gestão e atualização contínua do banco de talentos, apoiando a agilidade e assertividade nas contratações;
Atuar no alinhamento de perfil junto aos gestores, assegurando clareza de expectativas e direcionamento do processo seletivo;
Apoiar os processos de admissão, garantindo a correta organização das informações no sistema e o fluxo adequado para o time responsável;
Assegurar comunicação eficiente com candidatos ao longo de todas as etapas do processo, fortalecendo a experiência do candidato;
Apoiar a integração de novos colaboradores, contribuindo para uma jornada alinhada à cultura organizacional;
Monitorar e apoiar indicadores e relatórios de recrutamento, contribuindo para melhoria contínua dos processos;
Contribuir com ações de atração de talentos, especialmente para posições de alto volume.
Qualificações:
Ensino superior cursando em Gestão de RH, Psicologia ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência prévia em Recrutamento e Seleção.
Diferenciais:
Vivência com recrutamento de Pessoas com Deficiência;
Vivência com recrutamento em varejo e alto volume de vagas;
Experiência com plataformas como 99jobs, Pandapé, e Indeed;
Conhecimento em Excel.
Como é o ambiente de trabalho aqui:
Na DPSP (lojas, corporativo e CDs), temos um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, onde integração entre áreas é essencial para grandes resultados.
Mais do que igualdade, buscamos equidade: Aqui, temos espaço para sermos autênticos, independentemente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, credo ou deficiência.
Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCD).
Tipo de contrato: CLT;
Horário de trabalho: Segunda a sexta, das 08:00h às 17:48h (Atuação full presencial, com flexibilidade de horário);

title: Video Strategist
description:
WHO ARE WE?
Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState.
As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world's leading brands through data-driven content and technology.
Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we've built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.
WHY JOIN US?
At Launch Potato, you'll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.
Note: This is a contract-to-hire position
MUST HAVE:
Demonstrated experience driving video performance, engagement, and watch time, ideally in a revenue-focused environment
Strong understanding of video syndication platforms (MSN preferred) and how they reward engagement
Hands-on experience with scriptwriting, editing feedback, and video optimization
Comfort managing freelancers, assigning work, and overseeing quality and deadlines
Ability to analyze performance metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements
Strong organizational skills and comfort juggling multiple projects at once
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a remote environment
Willingness to experiment, test, and iterate quickly
Openness to incorporating AI tools into scripting, ideation, and workflow optimization
EXPERIENCE: 3+ years in video strategy, video production, or performance-driven video roles within digital media, performance marketing, or content monetization. Personal finance experience or familiarity strongly preferred.
YOUR ROLE
You'll own the strategy, planning, and performance of FinanceBuzz's video content, with a primary focus on syndication platforms (especially MSN) where revenue is driven by consumed seconds of video. Secondarily, you'll support video publishing and optimization for YouTube and social platforms.
This is a highly hands-on role. You'll be directly involved in topic selection, scripting, editing feedback, thumbnail and on-screen graphic optimization, and performance analysis. Your goal is simple but ambitious: scale video revenue significantly over time while maintaining high-quality, trustworthy personal finance content.
To succeed in this role, you'll need strong instincts for what keeps viewers watching, comfort working with performance data, and the ability to manage multiple contributors and workflows at once. You should be equally comfortable zooming out to plan a content roadmap and zooming in to rewrite a script or leave frame-by-frame feedback.
This role is contract-to-hire and will play a key role in growing video from its current state (~$15K/month) into a $500K+ annual revenue stream.
SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Selecting video topics that consistently maximize viewer engagement, watch time, and revenue
Optimizing scripts to increase retention, clarity, and completion rates
Improving thumbnail and on-screen graphic performance through testing and iteration
Building and maintaining an efficient, scalable video workflow
Managing freelancers effectively: assigning work, giving clear feedback, and coordinating payments and budgets
Maintaining high quality and brand consistency across all video content
Monitoring video performance metrics and proactively identifying opportunities for improvement
Growing video revenue from its current level toward a $500K+ annual run rate
Establishing FinanceBuzz as a trusted and engaging personal finance video brand
Core Responsibilities
Own the video content strategy for syndication platforms, with a primary focus on MSN
Plan and maintain the video content calendar
Write, edit, and optimize video scripts
Provide detailed feedback to video editors and designers
Optimize thumbnails, titles, and on-screen graphics for engagement
Oversee video production workflows for speed, quality, and consistency
Manage freelance contributors and coordinate with internal stakeholders on budgets and payments
Conduct quality control on all video outputs
Track and report on video performance metrics and revenue
COMPETENCIES
Performance-Driven: Obsessed with engagement, watch time, and revenue outcomes
Detail-Oriented: Catches issues before they go live and pushes for constant improvement
Strategic & Tactical: Thinks big-picture while staying deeply involved in execution
Ownership Mentality: Treats the video business as their own and takes responsibility for results
Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-changing environment and adjusts strategy based on performance data
Collaborative: Works closely with editorial, design, and operations partners
Coachability: Welcomes feedback and actively seeks ways to improve systems and output
Want to accelerate your career? Apply now

Essa é a Shoulder: Lugar que dá vontade de ficar.
Tudo começa com a nossa Roupa boa.
Desde os anos 80, a Shoulder veste o tempo da mulher que vive em evolução. Estamos com ela na rotina, no trabalho e até nos momentos mais especiais. Somos desejo, qualidade e conforto - sempre de um jeito sofisticado. Tudo bem "vestiu e foi", tudo bem Shoulder.
Por aqui, criamos moda de um jeito inspirador e possível, pensando em cada tempo e unindo elegância e qualidade. Em cada coleção, criamos peças 100% exclusivas, que vão do 34 ao 48, nessa mistura do que é atual com o toque atemporal.
Em todo lugar, o tempo todo.
Hoje, somos mais de 90 lojas em todos os estados do país, e nosso e-commerce veste de norte a sul. Nossa presença também se estende pra mais de 1.000 multimarcas. Por isso a gente adora dizer: estamos em todo Brasil, 24h, todos os dias.
Um lugar pra querer estar.
Com mais de 1.700 colaboradores, a gente acredita que ninguém faz nada grande sozinho — e que, quando um cresce, todo mundo cresce junto.
Nossa cultura procura incentivar o propósito que vira atitude. Incentiva a escuta atenta, a presença e o cuidado em cada detalhe — da criação da nossa Roupa boa até a experiência em loja. Pra gente, é tudo sobre respeito, colaboração e comunicação.

Estabelecer e cultivar relacionamentos duradouros com os clientes, garantindo uma experiência positiva tanto no processo de venda quanto no acompanhamento pós-venda, reforçando a confiança e a fidelidade à marca;

title: Marketing Program Manager
description:
About Cambly

Cambly is transforming how the world learns English. With millions of students across the globe and thousands of native English-speaking tutors, we've created a platform where real conversations lead to real fluency. We're not just another language app—we're building authentic human connections that break down barriers and open up opportunities.

As we expand, we're scaling our creative capabilities to match our global ambitions. This is where you come in.

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic, creative builder who can establish Cambly's voice in organic channels from the ground up—someone who sees the white space and knows how to own it. If you thrive on 0-to-1 challenges, love the intersection of content and growth, and want your work to directly impact millions of learners worldwide, this role is for you.

You'll own our SEO/AEO strategy and community presence, establishing sustainable channels that reduce our reliance on paid advertising while building trust and authority with professional English learners in Japan, Korea, and globally. This is a high-impact role where you'll create new programs, coordinate cross-functional teams, and directly influence Cambly's long-term growth trajectory.

*Note: this is a remote position for candidate who is based in Brazil but outside Rio.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Cambly's SEO/AEO program to increase organic search visibility and ranking for high-intent keywords across markets in APAC, LATAM, and Europe, including localized blog strategy, influencer partnerships for backlinks, and technical SEO implementation in partnership with the Product team.

  • Develop global social media strategy with localized content approaches for different markets and platforms, including Instagram optimization and YouTube expansion plans.

  • Outline measurable goals and create monthly reports on how we are tracking against them.

  • Create content strategy centered on social proof: user testimonials, tutor spotlights, student success stories, and product education that drives conversion and builds community trust.

  • Build community management frameworks for global platforms (including Naver - Korea, among others), local review sites, and global social channels with culturally relevant messaging.

  • Manage SEO content agencies and coordinate with creative teams (designers, video editors, copywriters) to produce high-quality, on-brand content at scale.

  • Track, analyze, and report on SEO, social, and community performance metrics to measure impact, inform strategy iterations, and present insights to leadership.

  • Partner with Growth, Product, and Marketing teams to align content strategy with business goals while monitoring competitive landscape and platform trends in target markets.

Requirements (Must-Haves)

  • 5+ years of experience in SEO, content strategy, or digital marketing with proven track record of building and scaling organic channels

  • Demonstrated expertise in SEO/AEO strategy, including technical SEO, content optimization, and link-building programs

  • Strong understanding of social media platforms, algorithms, and content strategies across multiple channels (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, etc.)

  • Experience developing and executing content strategies that drive measurable business results (traffic, engagement, conversion)

  • Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or content teams to produce high-quality work at scale

  • Proficiency with analytics tools (Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar) and ability to translate data into actionable insights

  • Excellent project management skills with ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously

  • Native in Portugese and excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with international or APAC markets, particularly Japan and Korea

  • Familiarity with AI tools for content optimization and SEO research

  • Experience in language learning, education technology, or subscription businesses

  • Knowledge of video content strategy for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok

  • Background managing influencer content programs or creator partnerships

title: Engenheiro de Suporte Técnico, Trilogy (Remote) - 60,000/year USD
description:
Customer support has become a battlefield of rising complexity and escalating expectations. Today's customers demand AI-driven, immediate solutions, yet most companies remain stuck in experimental phases, unable to transform AI into tangible results. The challenge is about to intensify. Industry forecasts suggest that by 2029, agentic systems will handle the majority of routine issues autonomously, creating a widening chasm between what customers expect and what organizations can deliver today.
Our approach bridges this divide through a distinct framework: AI-enhanced "cyborg" support specialists who combine sophisticated diagnostic expertise with product knowledge and agentic AI capabilities. In this position, you refine, repair, and mentor the technology. Each resolution strengthens our automation frameworks, every root cause investigation becomes a repeatable solution pattern, and every complex scenario you decode enhances system performance for thousands of future customers. This role sits at the intersection of advanced diagnostics, human judgment, and AI coordination to deliver superior resolutions now while building compounding intelligence for the future.
This position demands hands-on technical problem-solving at production scale. You will investigate ambiguous failures spanning networks, databases, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise applications; harness AI to formulate hypotheses, validate theories, and accelerate resolution; capture the human reasoning that trains our systems; and proactively identify patterns that convert one-time fixes into lasting automation. This is not about following scripts, sorting tickets, or escalating to senior engineers. If you excel at creative problem-solving when documentation is sparse, if you can pivot seamlessly from packet analysis to execution plans to workflow traces, and if you're confident challenging an LLM's conclusions, this role will suit you well.
What You Will Be Doing
AI-Enhanced Customer Problem Resolution: Investigate complex support cases escalated from AI systems, apply human judgment where AI capabilities are limited, and subsequently enhance the AI system to narrow those gaps
What You Won't Be Doing
Spending two full months onboarding; you will need to achieve proficiency across multiple products within your first month (we recognize this timeline is demanding)
Depending on management for assistance; if you cannot effectively remove your own obstacles, this role will present significant challenges
Engenheiro De Suporte Técnico Key Responsibilities
Combine technical human judgment with AI tools to provide outstanding customer support, concentrating on sophisticated problems that AI cannot yet independently address
Basic Requirements
Must be located in North or South America
Minimum of 3 years total experience in technical customer support positions
Fundamental coding abilities for troubleshooting and bug resolution purposes
Diagnostic Capabilities: Translating technical complexity into accessible explanations, exhibiting thorough problem comprehension, identifying appropriate troubleshooting approaches, presenting multiple resolution options, and maintaining meticulous attention to detail
About Trilogy
Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. For three decades, Trilogy has been known for 3 things: Relentlessly seeking top talent, Innovating new technology, and incubating new businesses. Our technological innovation is spearheaded by a passion for simple customer-facing designs. Our incubation of new businesses ranges from entirely new moon-shot ideas to rearchitecting existing projects for today's modern cloud-based stack. Trilogy is a place where you can be surrounded with great people, be proud of doing great work, and grow your career by leaps and bounds.
There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you
Working with us
This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $30 USD/hour, which equates to $60,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Working regular hours from a Ventura-RJ based Baker Hughes office.

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

With operations in over 120 countries, we provide better solutions for our customers and richer opportunities for our people. People who are as passionate as we are about making energy safer, cleaner and more efficient.
Join Us
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company with a global reach and exciting services and clients? Come join us and grow with a team of people who will energize and inspire you

Alguém que combine boa capacidade técnica com senso de prioridade e autonomia compatível com o nível da posição, contribuindo para a segurança jurídica das operações e para a tomada de decisões do negócio.

O time de Legal da Nuuvem atua de forma integrada às demais áreas da empresa, sendo responsável por apoiar temas como contratos, parcerias estratégicas, propriedade intelectual, compliance, proteção de dados, prevenção de riscos e conformidade regulatória. A área desempenha um papel essencial na sustentação e no crescimento do negócio, garantindo segurança jurídica com eficiência e agilidade.

Essa pessoa terá atuação generalista, com foco principal em contratos, apoiando as demandas jurídicas em diferentes frentes. No dia a dia, irá prestar suporte jurídico às áreas internas, acompanhar demandas jurídicas recorrentes, organizar informações e contribuir para a mitigação de riscos e a conformidade regulatória, com atuação próxima ao negócio no contexto do jurídico in-house.


Esta oportunidade é válida para trabalho remoto. Fornecemos todos os equipamentos necessários para você mandar bem no seu trabalho, seja ele onde você escolher ser Você só precisa garantir uma internet de qualidade

  • Formação em Direito, com graduação concluída ou em andamento a partir do 8º período.

  • Inscrição ativa na OAB ou elegibilidade comprovada para inscrição ao término da graduação.

  • Comunicação escrita e verbal adequada ao ambiente corporativo, com clareza e objetividade.

  • Conhecimento básico de inglês para leitura e elaboração de comunicações simples.

  • Disponibilidade para atuação generalista, com capacidade de lidar simultaneamente com demandas jurídicas de diferentes naturezas.

  • Conhecimento em Direito Contratual, com noções dos fundamentos de Direito Civil e Empresarial aplicados ao contexto corporativo.

  • Habilidade de análise jurídica, organização e atenção a detalhes, com foco em qualidade técnica e conformidade.

  • Atuação em equipe, com postura profissional, proativa e colaborativa, demonstrando responsabilidade e comprometimento com a evolução técnica.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em jurídico corporativo ou escritório de advocacia, incluindo atuação em estágio.

  • Vivência com contratos nacionais e internacionais, bem como atuação em ambiente corporativo, preferencialmente em empresas de tecnologia ou entretenimento.

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de tarefas e comunicação corporativa, como Slack, ClickUp ou equivalentes.

  • Inglês em nível avançado ou fluente.

  • Espanhol em qualquer nível.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar documentos jurídicos de baixa complexidade e apoiar a análise de documentos de média e alta complexidade, com foco em contratos, incluindo NDA, MoU, contratos e aditivos contratuais.

  • Elaborar pareceres jurídicos iniciais e minutas contratuais, de acordo com o escopo e o nível de responsabilidade da posição.

  • Atuar de forma generalista no suporte a demandas jurídicas de natureza cível, trabalhista, tributária, administrativa, propriedade intelectual e proteção de dados, conforme as necessidades.

  • Acompanhar demandas processuais e administrativas, realizando controle de prazos, organização documental e consolidação de informações.

  • Apoiar a interface com escritórios terceirizados, realizando follow ups, organização de subsídios e acompanhamento das entregas.

  • Prestar suporte jurídico às áreas internas em demandas recorrentes, com orientação técnica e foco em mitigação de riscos.

  • Utilizar ferramentas jurídicas e operacionais, incluindo sistemas de gestão contratual, plataformas de assinatura eletrônica e organização documental.

Importante: não deixe de aplicar caso não tenha todos os conhecimentos ou experiências acima Sua capacidade de aprendizado e evolução é mais importante do que um "checklist" de conhecimentos e experiências prévias.

Modalidade e Faixa Salarial

Founded in 1989, BCP Securities, Inc. is an American brokerage and investment bank focused on fixed income in emerging markets. · Bachelor's degree in Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or related fields.

· Strong communication skills to present and discuss analyses.
· Strong interest in financial markets, economic trends, and global events.

Differentials

Benefits

title: Change Management Business Partner
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.
Purpose
As a Change Management Business Partner, your role is to provide expert advisory services and support to a portfolio of change initiatives across the organization to ensure delivery of expected business outcomes through adoption and usage. You will partner with project teams, leaders, and stakeholders to embed change management best practices, build change capability, and drive adoption of change initiatives. By leveraging your expertise and insights, you will enable the successful execution of change projects and contribute to building a change-ready culture.
Responsibilities
As a Change Management Business Partner you are responsible for
Providing strategic guidance and advice to project teams and stakeholders on change management principles, methodologies, and tools to support the successful delivery of change initiatives
Partnering with project teams to develop and implement change management plans and activities, including communication plans, stakeholder engagement strategies, and resistance management tactics
Guiding, coaching the project team enabling them to fulfill their roles with the appropriate behaviors and actions to support the change plan
Delivering training programs, workshops, and materials to build change management capabilities among project teams, leaders, and employees
Capturing and sharing lessons learned, best practices, and success stories from change initiatives to inform future projects and enhance organizational change management capability
Continuously assessing and refining change management approaches and tools to ensure relevance and effectiveness in supporting change efforts
Education
Master degree prefered in Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, Change Management, or related field
Experience
Experience in providing change management advisory services in a complex organizational environment.
Functional Competencies
Stakeholder mapping
Training, facilitation services delivery
Community management
Analytics and reporting
Business Partnering
Business Acumen
Internal project management
Change Management
Resistance Management

title: Manager, Volunteer Engagement
description:
Department: Workforce, People & Culture
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Communications & Engagement Manager will play a central role in shaping, delivering, and elevating the end-to-end communications and engagement strategy for the FIFA Volunteer Programme across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.
The purpose of this role is to oversee the development, coordination, and execution of all volunteer-related communications and engagement initiatives. This includes creating and implementing the overall communications plan, leading launch and promotional campaigns, managing key milestones, and delivering a structured and aligned content plan across both internal and external channels to ensure consistent and impactful communication. The successful candidate will also drive the engagement strategy covering activations such as the trophy tour, ambassador participation, mascot appearances, and partner-related activities to further build motivation, visibility, and community among volunteers.
This role will collaborate closely with the Volunteer Management team in FIFA Zurich, eight Host Cities in Brazil, the Brand and Marketing teams, external agencies, and other Functional Areas to ensure consistent, high-quality messaging and impactful engagement touchpoints throughout the volunteer journey. This will include all touch points from launch to internal communication to volunteers.
We are seeking an experienced communications professional with a proven track record in managing complex, large-scale communications campaigns for events and in designing informative, motivating, and culturally relevant engagement initiatives to lead the Volunteer Programme communications for diverse volunteer audiences (local and international) from the application phase through tournament-time. The ideal candidate understands mindset of volunteer, can translate local context into global communications frameworks, has experience in large-scale event delivery and thrives in a dynamic, multicultural environment.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead the development and implementation of the FWWC27 Volunteer Communications & Engagement Strategy including the initial launch of the volunteer programme,
Ensure alignment with FIFA Women's World Cup strategy, FIFA's global volunteer communications and engagement strategy, brand guidelines, and tournament timelines
Act as the primary liaison with FIFA Zurich, FIFA 27, Host Cities, and external agencies on topics related to communications and engagement.
Deliver key communication and engagement milestones from planning, recruitment through to tournament-time and post-event legacy.
Co-lead communications related to the volunteer launch campaign, including messaging, creative briefs, KPIs, and rollout.
Draft and prepare engaging written, visual and digital content (in English and Portuguese) throughout the full journey for the volunteer platform, website, social media, FAQs, newsletters, volunteer support channel and operational communications.Right to work in Brazil.
Identify opportunities to highlight the Volunteer Programme via Media and Public Relations support.
Coordinate and integrate Host Country communications and messaging into a unified, coherent strategy that reflects the tournament's values, brand, and legacy objectives.
Provide Host Cities with communication toolkits, guidelines, and templates.
Ensure messaging consistency, accuracy, cultural relevance and crisis communication when required.
Ensure all internal and external messaging supports programme goals, celebrates volunteer contributions, and strengthens volunteer satisfaction and retention.
Oversee end-to-end planning and delivery of assigned communications projects, ensuring alignment between internal teams, host cities, external agencies, and other key partners.
Manage external stakeholders and agencies, defining requirements, providing clear briefs, aligning expectations, and ensuring an efficient end-to-end RFP process.
Lead development and execution of volunteer engagement initiatives including but not limited to trophy tour activations, ambassador and mascot appearances, partner-related activities and tournament time engagement activities in volunteer centres.
Prepare and deliver communication and engagement how to materials, for FIFA27 and Host City team members to understand how to deliver communication and engagement deliverables.
Act as the liaison with Marketing, Brand & Communications teams to ensure consistency in brand, messaging, and tone, while providing cross-functional support to other divisions including Digital, Media Relations, Content Production, and Event Communications.
Track and report performance of communications campaigns, content reach, engagement levels, and activation impact.
Provide regular updates to the Senior Volunteer Manager and FIFA27 top management and work closely with the FIFA Zurich team to ensure alignment with the global FIFA Volunteer Programme strategy.
Capture lessons learned and feed them into continuous improvement for future events.
YOUR PROFILE
Minimum 5+ years of communications experience, preferably within major events or large-scale volunteer programmes.
University degree in Communications, Marketing, Public Relations, Business or related field.
Masters in Sports Management or Event Management is an asset.
Proven experience in delivering FIFA tournaments, major sports events or other international events is advantageous.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to craft clear, engaging messages.
Creative thinking with a keen sense for storytelling and brand innovation.
Proven expertise in content creation, social media strategy, and media relations.
Familiarity with volunteer management systems and related IT tools is a plus.
Strong project management skills with experience delivering campaigns or large-scale communication plans.
Comfortable working with creative tools and platforms (e.g., Adobe Suite, CMS/web design platforms, Photoshop, Final Cut Pro, Audacity. Additional qualification in web design or animation is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to coordinate across departments and manage relationships with diverse stakeholders.
Demonstrated success in delivering audience engagement strategies and activation events.
Experience working in multicultural environments; knowledge of Brazil/South America sport and cultural ecosystem is an advantage.
Positive, collaborative, solutions-driven mindset; able to work autonomously and under tight timelines.
Team-oriented and passion for volunteerism, community engagement, diversity, inclusion, and gender empowerment.
Experience working with culturally diverse teams across multiple locations/time zones.
Understanding of volunteer motivation and behaviour across different cultural contexts.
Budget Management and oversee service provider deliverables
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Security Investigator
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat Relocation Package.
Job Overview
We are seeking a Security Investigator to join our Corporate Security Department (CSD).
CSD is responsible for providing highly specialized professional, investigative and consulting services to Saudi Aramco's Corporate and Executive Management, in order to safeguard the Company and its communities.
Your primary role is to conduct Company based investigations, in respect of serious and complex issues, including, but not limited to fraud, business ethics, abuse of authority, conflict of interest, misuse of resources, harassment, crimes against the person, anti-social behavior, unsafe acts, cybersecurity and data leakage.
Key Responsibilities
As the successful candidate, you will be required to perform the following:
Conduct and lead highly complex and sensitive misconduct investigations, in accordance with legal norms, with specific reference to and compliance with Saudi Labor Law and relevant Company Policies and Procedures.
Initiate, administer and plan investigations, and present the case findings to internal control organizations.
Provide regular briefings supported by detailed, evidential reports and information to Corporate and Executive Management, in addition to line management.
Perform interviews to identify and develop facts to resolve investigative issues and expediently prepare high quality, well-structured and evidential professional reports of investigation.
Identify, prevent and detect wrongdoing or offending
Provide misconduct and cybersecurity awareness programs throughout the Company.
Identify cost savings, reimbursements and recoveries in favor of Saudi Aramco arising from investigative findings and recommend relevant business change practices and lessons learned to mitigate and negate current and future risks.
Conduct detailed research (from open and closed sources) and crime pattern/risk analysis, to identify trends, hot spots, actual or potential corporate threats and vulnerabilities.
Maintain and organize investigation case files to a high quality and auditable standard in compliance with data protection norms.
Liaise with Company stakeholders and external parties as required, in progressing and reviewing investigative outcomes and risk mitigation strategies.
Coach and develop junior investigators and keep abreast of investigative techniques and legal norms.
Minimum Requirements
You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Criminal Justice, Criminology, Police Sciences or Security Studies. Degrees in the following disciplines are also acceptable: Business and Management, Computer & Information Systems, and Police Administration.
You will have nine (9) years of experience in law enforcement and/or corporate investigations with a proven ability in conducting complex cases of investigation, in respect of fraud, business ethics, abuse of authority, conflict of interest, misuse of resources, harassment, crimes against the person, anti-social behavior, unsafe acts, cybersecurity and data leakage etc.
You will be able to demonstrate excellent organizational, analytical and evidential skills, when conducting investigations and presenting relevant findings.
You must have excellent report writing skills and the ability to structure and summarize case findings in a concise, logical and articulate manner in compliance with legal norms.
You will be able to build effective work relationships in a diverse and multi-cultural environment is a necessity.
You will have a recognized professional certification, in related disciplines, such as a Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Professional Certified Investigator (PCI), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), International Compliance Association (ICA), Certified Forensic Interviewer (CFI) or equivalent.
Working Environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Engenheiro de Segurança do Trabalho Júnior
description:
A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.
Nossos Valores:
Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga:
Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro de Segurança do Trabalho que será responsável por contribuir com a gestão de saúde e segurança da empresa, incluindo identificação, mensuração e proposta para mitigação dos riscos de saúde e segurança nos projetos e obras da NTS.
Responsabilidades:
Desdobrar a Política de Sustentabilidade da NTS com o objetivo assegurar o cumprimento com os valores de respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente da empresa.
Contribuir para melhoria contínua do Sistema de Gestão Integrada da NTS por meio da da revisão de procedimentos de SSMA, contribuir para implementação dos processos nos projetos com o objetivo de diminuir o número de incidentes na empresa.
Propor diretrizes de gerenciamento de riscos de Saúde e Segurança, contribuir com a implementação das ferramentas de risco da NTS (AR, LPR, PT, etc), para diminuir os cenários de risco de processo alto e muito alto, prevenindo a ocorrência de incidentes.
Atendimento aos requisitos legais de saúde e segurança nos projetos da NTS (Normas Regulamentadoras).
Fiscalização de obras para garantir o cumprimento dos requisitos legais por parte dos prestadores de serviço.
Contribuir com a qualificação da mão de obra de prestadores de serviço, desenvolvendo conhecimentos e cultura atrelados a saúde e segurança. Apresentar os riscos das atividades, política e norma NTS e a importância de gerenciar riscos e desenvolver comportamentos seguros.
Contribuir com o desenvolvimento de diretrizes e capacitação dos prestadores de serviço para que estejam aptos para lidar com emergências nos projetos da NTS. (Avaliar os Planos de Emergência dos prestadores de serviço dos projetos da NTS)
Garantir o gerenciamento eficiente dos incidentes e não conformidades, de modo que ocorrências indesejáveis sejam mitigadas e não voltem a ocorrer.
Realizar inspeções e auditorias periódicas nos prestadores de serviço, com objetivo de avaliar sua gestão em SSMA
Requisitos:
Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia.
Especialização em Segurança do Trabalho.
Informática (Pacote Office: Word, Power Point, Excel, Outlook)
Conhecimento normas ISO 9001, ISO 14001 e ISO 45001.
Conhecimento em Gestão de Projetos.
Diferencial:
Inglês intermediário/avançado.
Como se preparar para o processo seletivo:
Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.

Entrevista com o Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?
Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.
